messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 EVAL-GATE ALERT  — severity=P1 — prompt-eval: safety_regression_count=14 (threshold=3) — paging oncall. Gate: 'prod-prompt-safety-v2' triggered. Eval job: evals/weekly/2026-03-14/runner-27. PagerDuty: PD#INC-8382

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident INC-8382 triggered and paged rotation team (oncall: AlexB).

AlexB: acked on PagerDuty, oncall here. Pulling up eval run.

AlexB: quick note — this fired right after the latest prompt hint rollout (rollout id r-2026-03-14-07). Possible correlation.

Priya: copying ML infra — @ML-Rahul can you confirm if any model variant or tokenization changed around that rollout?

ML-Rahul: seeing the rollout details now. No model binaries changed, just prompt metadata and a new safety prompt template. Rolling eval shows spike in 'unsafe-phrase' rate for top-100 user queries from 0.9% -> 6.7%.

Jon: can we capture sample inputs/outputs? Need to assess customer impact.

SRE-Lina: pinging logging infra — query: `service:inference name:prompt-safety tag:prod @rollout:r-2026-03-14-07 | top 50 outputs` — returning some hits, pushing sample bundle to /tmp/eval_incident_8382.tar.gz

Megan: I pulled 20 samples — 3 of them are clearly unsafe (explicit content returned). Looks like the new safety prompt was inadvertently appended in a way that lowered safety steering for a small class of edge prompts.

AlexB: action plan: 1) block the rollout (toggle to 0%) 2) switch routing for critical customers to fallback prompt template 3) start a quick revert of prompt metadata 4) monitor metrics for 30m.

Priya: how to block rollout: `curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://console.api.redwood/v1/rollouts/r-2026-03-14-07/abort` — that's the abort endpoint.

AlexB: executing now.

AlexB: `> curl .../abort` -> 200 OK. Rollout aborted and halted at 12% traffic.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-8382 acknowledged by AlexB. Escalation paused.

ML-Rahul: initiating fallback routing: bumping prompt-template to prod:prompt-template:v1-stable for routes tagged enterprise/critical. Command: `rbw config set /prompts/prod/default-template v1-stable --scope customers:enterprise`

Jon: can we confirm which customers saw bad outputs? Any large accounts?

SRE-Lina: cross-checking request logs for spikes in safety flags across customer IDs... quick grep shows 3 customer IDs with >5 bad outputs in last 10m: cust-42, cust-118, cust-207. Two are internal dev customers, cust-207 is external (mid-market).

Megan: pinging CS -> @Priya can you let the CS lead know about cust-207 and draft a proactive message? We should say we're investigating and have rolled back the prompt change.

Priya: will draft. ETA 10m.

AlexB: ML-Rahul, how long to fully revert prompt metadata to pre-rollout state?

ML-Rahul: revert in config-store takes <2m. Deploy propagation ~5-10m. I'll kick it now: `rbw config revert /prompts/prod --to-tag pre-rollout-20260314`

ML-Rahul: revert submitted, propagation started.

incident-bot: Monitoring: metric prod.safety.unsafe_rate (1m) — pre=0.9% — now=3.2% and trending down after rollback.

AlexB: good. Starting 1:1 monitoring on logs and alerts. Setting a 30m watch. If unsafe_rate doesn't drop under 1.5% in 30m we escalate to exec oncall.

Megan: note for postmortem: gate threshold maybe too low or false negative coverage for that edge class. Also eval dataset didn't include these user query shapes.

Priya: CS drafted notify to cust-207: "We've identified an issue with a recent prompt update that may have affected some outputs. We've halted the change and reverted to the prior prompt template. We're monitoring and will follow up with a full summary." Sending now.

Jon: any observable latency impacts from the revert?

SRE-Lina: no significant latency change. GPU/CPU metrics stable.

AlexB: PagerDuty -> setting incident severity to P1 (we paged already). Adding runbook link: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/prompt-safety-incident

Priya: can we run a targeted eval (quick job) on the failure cases to ensure fix? Rahul — can you run the eval harness on the captured sample bundle?

ML-Rahul: launching quick eval: `python3 -m evals.run --input /tmp/eval_incident_8382.tar.gz --model prod-latest --safety-checks only` — started. ETA ~8m.

incident-bot: Eval job evals/quick/INC-8382-run1 queued.

ML-Rahul: first results in — unsafe_count 1/20, previously 3/20. Good sign. Running full pass.

AlexB: monitoring dashboards. Unsafe rate trending 0.9% -> 0.6% in the last 6m.

pagerduty-bot: Status update posted to INC-8382 (ack by AlexB).

Jon: preparing short blameless summary for leadership slack channel once stabilized. Include root cause hypothesis: prompt template concatenation bug + eval coverage gap.

Megan: creating followup tasks: (1) add failing queries to eval suite, (2) add canary rollout check for 'user-shape X' detection, (3) add stricter gate threshold for safety regression.

AlexB: handing off to Priya for oncall overlap — I'm out for a brief meeting in 10m. Priya, take on monitoring and customer comms until I return in ~30m.

Priya: taking over. I'll keep the watch and ping if unsafe_rate > 1.5% or new customer hits.

Megan: thanks everyone. Good containment. Post-incident tasks assigned in the tracker: TASK-7421, TASK-7422, TASK-7423.

Priya: incident timeline for postmortem: root cause analysis due EOD. I'll start collecting artifacts (rollout diffs, eval runs, sample outputs).

AlexB: back — thanks Priya. Closing PagerDuty alert if metrics stay stable for another 20m.

incident-bot: monitoring note — unsafe_rate remained <1.5% for 22m. No new customer hits.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-8382 status: resolved (condition met).

Priya: creating postmortem stub now. Will link eval logs and notes.

Megan: quick retro note: add a pre-rollout sanity eval that includes a synthetic corpus for 'user-shape X'.

AlexB: good first response. We'll iterate on detection and gates. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
